description: How the customer roles of the household-finance brokerage relate to each other: which households ask which advisors for advice, how experts and customer-care advisors work with banks and providers to compare, submit and switch, how referral commissions flow from partners through head office to the office network, and which information loops (rates, tariffs, certification, alerts) keep the network running.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Requests for advice, mandates and contracts concluded between households, advisors and partners

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day comparison, file assembly, submission, switch and cancellation work

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Referral commissions, reconciliation and payout across partners, head office and the office network

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Rates, tariffs, certification, reporting and alerts that flow between roles

relations.name: Books a mortgage advice appointment
relations.description: Books an appointment in the nearest hypotheek.winkel office or by video call after a simulation, a Google review or a referral, and asks the expert to compare 25 banks for the first home.

relations.name: Asks for a proposal review or refinancing case
relations.description: Uploads a proposal received from their own bank or elsewhere, or opens a refinancing, renovation-loan, second-home or new-build case, and expects a quick expert verdict on whether it can be beaten.

relations.name: Issues the feasibility certificate and guides the file
relations.description: Maps the buyer's situation, issues the feasibility certificate the buyer shows to sellers, collects income, savings, compromis and EPC documents and follows the file through approval to the notary deed.

relations.name: Submits the credit file
relations.description: Assembles a complete, compliant credit file for the chosen bank, submits it through the broker channel and tracks approval, conditions and disbursement.

relations.name: Publishes daily conditions and approval decisions
relations.description: Provides the daily mortgage conditions that feed the 25-bank comparison and returns approvals, declines and conditions on submitted files.

relations.name: Concludes the loan contract with the bank
relations.description: Signs the mortgage loan with the chosen bank at the notary; Peasy stays on the sidelines because the contract is always concluded with the partner, and the buyer pays nothing extra for the brokerage.

relations.name: Pays a referral commission per concluded loan
relations.description: Pays the referral commission for every loan concluded through the broker channel to Peasy head office, where it is reconciled against submitted and approved files.

relations.name: Hands off outstanding-balance and fire insurance
relations.description: Passes the outstanding-balance and fire insurance needed for the loan to customer care for quotes across 11 insurers and policy binding before the deed, turning one mortgage into a household relationship.

relations.name: Requests a comparison and switch
relations.description: Asks by phone, chat, callback or after the budget barometer to compare and switch car, fire, funeral or outstanding-balance insurance, electricity and gas, internet/TV packs or mobile plans.

relations.name: Executes the switch and cancels the old contract
relations.description: Binds the chosen policy or places the energy or telecom switch order, terminates the old contract (including BIPT Easy Switch for telecom) and confirms the outcome in one contact where possible.

relations.name: Sends quote requests and switch orders
relations.description: Requests quotes and sends bind, switch and cancellation orders to the insurer, energy supplier or telecom operator selected in the comparison module.

relations.name: Supplies tariff and product updates
relations.description: Delivers tariff feeds, product conditions and availability changes that keep the insurance, energy and telecom comparison modules and advisor scripts accurate.

relations.name: Pays a referral fee per switched contract
relations.description: Pays the referral fee for every policy bound or switch concluded through Peasy's brands and reconciles leads, contracts and commissions with head office without disputes.

relations.name: Pays out commissions to the office
relations.description: Reconciles the referral commissions received from more than 50 partners against the office's concluded files and pays the office its commission share on a statement the franchisee can check.

relations.name: Engages experts and shares commission
relations.description: Recruits and retains the experts working in the office and passes on a share of the office commission per concluded file, alongside local marketing and office support.

relations.name: Routes leads and reports production
relations.description: Routes website, callback and upload leads to the nearest office and provides production, conversion and commission dashboards, plus office onboarding and franchise support.

relations.name: Certifies through the academy and sets compliance rules
relations.description: Trains and certifies experts in the academy (about 30 advisors per year) against FSMA knowledge requirements and sets advice-record, complaint and GDPR standards that every file must meet.

relations.name: Sends savings alerts from contract monitoring
relations.description: Keeps an eye on the brokered contracts stored per household and warns the family when a better or cheaper option exists, proposing a re-comparison and a new switch.
